desc:
Welcome to Tesla Autopilot!

Drive some of the newest and best electric cars Tesla has to offer! The Model X, Model S, Model 3, Model Y, and even the Cybertruck.
There are 30+ configurations to choose from, with different trims, options and colours, so you can find the one that feels just right. Make it yours with window tint, wheel and caliper colours, ride height, camber and stiffness, then save up to 12 builds to spawn anytime.

Let the car take over with Autopilot, or go all in with Full Self-Driving: pick a destination and it handles traffic lights, stop signs, turns and other cars all by itself. It'll even park itself with Autopark, and Smart Summon brings your car straight to you for free.

Everything's interactive too: working door handles, moving parts, realistic lighting, automatic emergency braking, a detailed AutoOS screen with live visualisations and parking sensors, and a bunch of smaller details that make the cars feel real!
